description: This is a test class for the AlertValidator, containing unit tests that verify the validation logic for Alert objects in the OpenMRS project. It tests various validation scenarios such as null or empty alert text, whitespace handling, correct validation when valid data is provided, and maximum length constraints.

classes.name: AlertValidatorTest
classes.description: Test class for the AlertValidator, verifying various validation rules for Alert objects.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes AlertValidator, Alert instance, and Errors before each test.

methods.name: shouldFailValidationIfAlertTextIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that validation fails when Alert text is null.

methods.name: shouldFailValidationIfAlertTextIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks that validation fails when Alert text is an empty string.

methods.name: shouldFailValidationIfAlertTextIsOnlyWhitespaces
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if Alert text contains only whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllRequiredValuesAreSet
methods.description: Verifies that validation passes when Alert has valid text.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Checks that validation fails when Alert text exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: assertThatFieldTextHasError
methods.description: Asserts that there are validation errors for the 'text' field.
